## Summary of Changes

A concise explanation of the changes made in this Pull Request and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security enhancement

## Security & Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the 100% offline security boundary (no outbound HTTP/telemetry).
- [ ] Any memory handling plaintext secrets implements `ZeroizeOnDrop` or `Zeroize`.
- [ ] Unit & integration tests have been run locally: `cargo test --workspace` passes.
- [ ] Frontend build succeeds without TypeScript errors: `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Conventional Commit format used in commit messages.
